# 3A Technology Solutions — Complete Reference Guide

> Nigerian software studio and training academy building web applications, custom business software, AI tools, data systems, and brand identities, while teaching practical tech skills through 3A Techvolution Academy.

## 2. Five Brand Personality Pillars

1. **Smart:** We communicate with intelligence and substance, without unnecessary complexity.
2. **Simple:** We reduce complexity and present technology in a way people can understand and use.
3. **Professional:** Every touchpoint should feel intentional, reliable, polished and credible.
4. **Human:** We speak to people, not machines. We are approachable, respectful and practical.
5. **Future-Ready:** We embrace modern technology while staying focused on real-world outcomes.

## 3. Commercial Services (`/services`)

### 3.1 Web & Digital Product Development (`/services/web-development`)
- **Summary:** Fast, accessible company websites, customer portals, and web applications built with React and Next.js.
- **Deliverables:** Company Websites & Web Applications, Landing Pages & Lead Intake Forms, Mobile-First Responsive Layouts, Technical SEO & Page Speed Tuning, Customer & Partner Web Portals.

### 3.2 Custom Software Engineering (`/services/custom-software`)
- **Summary:** Internal business tools, record-keeping systems, database backends, and APIs built around how your team actually works.
- **Deliverables:** Internal Operations & Inventory Tools, Digital Record & Logbook Portals, REST APIs & Backend Services, Spreadsheet-to-Database Migrations, System Handover Documentation.

### 3.3 Artificial Intelligence & Automation (`/services/ai-automation`)
- **Summary:** Practical AI assistants, document extraction tools, and automated workflows that cut down repetitive manual work.
- **Deliverables:** Automated Document & Invoice Readers, Internal Knowledge Search Assistants, Multi-Step Workflow Automations, WhatsApp & Email Triage Routing, AI Readiness & Workflow Reviews.

### 3.4 Data Science & Analytics (`/services/data-science-analytics`)
- **Summary:** Clear business dashboards, forecasting models, data cleaning pipelines, and computer vision tools.
- **Deliverables:** Automated Data Cleaning Pipelines, Forecasting & Classification Models, Computer Vision & Image Analysis Tools, Interactive Reporting Dashboards, Data Audits & Summary Reports.

### 3.5 Branding & Digital Media (`/services/brand-digital-media`)
- **Summary:** Logo systems, brand style guides, pitch decks, and digital media templates that give your business a clear, consistent look.
- **Deliverables:** Brand Identity Standards Guides, Vector Logos & Icon Sets, Pitch Decks & Presentation Templates, Social Media & Banner Templates, Print & Digital Marketing Assets.

---

## 4. 3A Techvolution Academy (`/academy` & `/academy/programmes`)

3A Techvolution Academy is our training wing where university students, NYSC members, graduates, and career switchers learn software development by writing code and building real projects.

### How Students Learn:
- **Real Working Projects:** Build and deploy complete web apps, data pipelines, and AI tools from week one.
- **Direct Code Reviews:** Working software engineers review student code weekly and help debug real issues.
- **A Portfolio You Can Show:** Students finish with a clean GitHub profile and live projects to show employers.

### Active Courses:
1. **Practical Software Engineering & Web Development (12 Weeks, Hybrid, Beginner):** JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Zod form validation, REST APIs, Git, and deployment.
2. **Applied Artificial Intelligence & Workflow Automation (8 Weeks, Weekend Cohort, Intermediate):** Prompt engineering, vector databases, RAG pipelines, webhook automations, and AI cost/privacy controls.
3. **Practical Data Science & Machine Learning (10 Weeks, In-Person, Intermediate):** Python, Pandas, statistical analysis, supervised/unsupervised ML, OpenCV computer vision, and model API deployment.

---

## 5. Projects & Case Studies (`/projects`)

1. **MarketMind AI** (`ai-automation`, *Live Production*): Automated market research tool that gathers industry news, tracks competitors, and summarizes key findings into short briefs.
2. **Deforestation Analysis Platform** (`data-science-analytics`, *Research & Development*): Satellite image analysis pipeline using Python, OpenCV, and PyTorch to track tree cover loss over time.
3. **Medicinal Plant Recognition System** (`data-science-analytics`, *Deployed Prototype*): Mobile image classifier built with TensorFlow Lite and React Native that identifies local Nigerian medicinal plants from leaf photos.
4. **High-Performance Image Compression Tool** (`web-development`, *Live Production*): Browser-based WebAssembly image compressor that converts large photos into WebP and AVIF files on-device without server uploads.
5. **Enterprise Electronic Logbook** (`custom-software`, *Deployed Prototype*): Offline-ready digital shift and activity logbook replacing paper journals with searchable records and signed handovers.
